text:
Priya (Finance): Morning — nightly reconciliation shows 93 Stripe payments succeeded but 47 missing in NetSuite. Noticed at 04:00 UTC. Can payments/ops triage?

Marco (Payments): Checking Stripe delivery logs now. Did we change webhook handling last night?

webhook-bot: ALERT: webhook failures detected for /webhooks/netsuite 03:52:10 - 04:05:00 UTC. Failed events: 47. Error breakdown: 39 x SignatureVerificationError, 8 x UpstreamHTTP(500). See /ops/webhooks/alerts/1742460000

Ivy (Backend): We rotated NETSUITE_WEBHOOK_SECRET during the 03:45 deploy and tightened timestamp tolerance to 300s. Logs show many rejects with "SignatureVerificationError: timestamp outside tolerance" starting 03:52.

Jon (Ops): I rolled the previous secret back into the billing-sync env as temporary fallback at 03:56 and restarted pods. Monitoring now.

Ivy (Backend): Adding dual-secret verification for 24h and changing create retry: treat NetSuite 409 (externalId exists) as idempotent -> GET existing. Pushing hotfix.

webhook-bot: DEPLOYMENT: billing-sync v2.16.0-hotfix deployed by Ivy at 04:01 UTC. Health checks passing.

Marco (Payments): Sample Stripe event: evt_3MnoPq - invoice.payment_succeeded, metadata.external_invoice_id="INV-2026-03-25-128". Pushed to backfill queue.

Jon (Ops): Opened NS ticket NS-9955 with NetSuite: flagged partial create traces and external_id collisions. Requested cleanup of partials prior to backfill.

Priya (Finance): Export exceptions CSV for CS: stripe_event, external_invoice_id, customer_email, amount_cents, currency, stripe_status. Need it ASAP.

Ivy (Backend): CSV saved to /finance/recon/ops/1742460000-missing_invoices.csv. Backfill queued but holding on NetSuite clearance.

webhook-bot: JOB: recon-backfill queued (job_id=rb-1742460000-1).

Marco (Payments): NetSuite responded: will clear 5 partial records within 90 minutes and asked us to pause retries. Case NS-9955 updated.

Ivy (Backend): Backfill plan: dedupe by stripe_event id and external_invoice_id, attempt create -> on 409 GET existing, on 5xx flag for manual review. Will post progress.

webhook-bot: BACKFILL-PROGRESS: processed=47, created=42, fetched_existing=0, blocked=5 (pending NS cleanup). Detailed CSV: /finance/recon/ops/1742460000-missing_invoices.csv

Priya (Finance): Impact summary: 47 events, payments captured in Stripe for all. 42 invoices created post-backfill, 5 pending. No duplicate charges found. Please include root cause and remediation in a short postmortem: secret rotation + strict verifier + retry logic treating 409 as retryable.

Jon (Ops): Added alert: webhook.signature.failures > 10 within 5m -> notify #eng-oncall and #finance. Also added runbook step: when rotating signing secrets, notify Payments + Finance and update Stripe endpoint secret via API if possible.

Ivy (Backend): Drafting postmortem and PRs: dual-secret verifier, 409->fetch idempotency, integration test for secret rotation. ETA draft: EOD.

Priya (Finance): Thanks team. CS has the CSV and will message affected customers with status. Ping this thread when NetSuite confirms cleanup and postmortem is posted. :thumbsup:
